notes: Both imperatives carry an emphatic he with no English of its own; both are unrepresented under rule 32.
עַל is left unrepresented because the ASV writes 'Keep the door' with a bare object, spending no word on the preposition's own relation (rule 40).
לְפִי is split rather than fused: the ASV writes 'before' for the preposition and 'mouth' for the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet (rule 2).
